title: Campaign Performance Report
subtitle: Transform raw campaign data into a visual story that drives the Q4 budget decision.
ai_tool: Any AI tool (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, Gemini)

data_files.role: 4 sheets: Campaign Summary (8 KPIs vs target), Channel Performance (6 channels, CPO ranking), Monthly Trend (Jul–Sep), Audience Segments (by buyer persona)
1-page Q4 context: approved budget envelope ($1.85M), recommended channel reallocation, decision required (roundtable expansion)
Genpact brand logo — attach so the AI embeds it in the report header
Design system: blue #1D4ED8 accent, green/red channel performance coding, card patterns — attach so the AI matches this visual standard
Target report layout: hero attainment stat, channel CPO bar chart, conversion funnel, reallocation cards — attach so the AI matches this layout

learning_objectives: Frame the campaign story before writing any prompt — form your budget verdict and decide what the report must argue
Write your own AI prompt using a 5-area scaffold: audience, data, design, what to build, output rules
Test your first output against the data file — verify at least 3 figures before you iterate
Improve with one targeted follow-up instead of re-prompting from scratch
Deliver a decision-ready campaign report that replaces a 20-slide deck with one interactive HTML file — no server, no install, no dependencies
deliverable: Single-file interactive HTML campaign performance report
